issue_context.title: example_cluster_dns.go relies on GOPATH, examples/ files
issue_context.body:
**What happened**:

We've been doing some release readiness and auditing all `sig-network` tagged ginkgo tests...  Looks like The example_cluster_dns.go test seems to expect a GOPATH when running.  Im seeing some failures in sonobuoy and suspect a possible relation there but havent dove into it.

Either way, its clear this test might need some updating/fixing/cleanuping and parts can be rewritten/improved.

**What you expected to happen**:

- No reliance on GOPATH for an e2e test

... I dont remember the whole history on this, but no tests that rely on static files currently look in gopath,  from what i can tell ?  instead we plumbed in a repo-root/ option a few years ago.  There may be a state of the art in terms of how we do this.... but i thought it was `repo-root` at one point which was an option passed in.

**How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)**:

Try to run this in sonobuoy or any other environment where there's no GOPATH or non-standard source trees, pretty sure it might not work. 

**Anything else we need to know?**:

I think the fix here is to just embed the YAML in golang like we do in other tests. along the way there's other cleanup we can do to improve this test.

**Environment**:
- Kubernetes version (use `kubectl version`): master
